candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 preceding order 502 and checkout 502 across all sampled correlation IDs; inventory/reservations succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; payment 503 root cause (config, saturation, dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations, with order then returning 502 and gateway /v1/checkout returning 502; inventory reservations succeed. Gateway metrics show elevated 502 rate on /v1/checkout. The bounded candidate is downstream payment failure propagating to checkout; payment's own fault cause remains unestablished.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs/metrics explaining the 503 on /v1/authorizations
Gateway logs (excluded) to confirm error propagation path
